metadata.title: Is Ursa Major II the Progenitor of the Orphan Stream?

notes: No eligible stars. UMa II: the paper’s “unbound” language refers to stars escaping the UMa II remnant, not becoming unbound from the Milky Way (T:p5-b6, T:p8-b3); UMa II itself is modeled on a bound Galactic orbit with perigalacticon 18.4 kpc and apogalacticon 40.6 kpc (T:p3-b7). Palomar 1, Ruprecht 106, Arp 2, and Terzan 7: discussed only as possible Orphan Stream associates, not as Galactic unbound candidates (T:p3-b11, T:p3-b12).
